bracu_official.title: BRAC University to Host Second Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed Memorial International Moot Court Competition
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University is set to host its second international moot court competition, honoring Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed. This event will bring together participants for a significant legal competition.

bracu_official.title: Class Schedule for Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: The official class schedule for the Fall 2026 semester has been released. Students are advised to check the updated schedule for their courses.

bracu_official.title: Application for the 18th Convocation
bracu_official.summary: A notice has been issued regarding the application process for the university's 18th Convocation. Graduating students should refer to the notice for application details and deadlines.

bracu_official.title: First Year Advising Team (FYAT), Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: Information about the First Year Advising Team (FYAT) for the Fall 2026 semester has been made available. New students are encouraged to connect with their assigned advisors for guidance.

bracu_official.title: Final Examinations
bracu_official.summary: The date for the final examinations is scheduled for December 10, 2026. Students should prepare accordingly for their end-of-semester assessments.

bracu_official.title: Mid-Term Exams week
bracu_official.summary: The mid-term examinations week is scheduled to commence on November 21, 2026. Students are advised to review their course materials in preparation.

bracu_official.title: Durga Puja (Bijoya Dashami) - University Closed
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University will be closed on October 20, 2026, in observance of Durga Puja (Bijoya Dashami). All academic and administrative activities will be suspended on this day.

bracu_official.title: Semester/Course Withdraw With W Grade (No Refund)
bracu_official.summary: This notice clarifies the policy for semester or course withdrawal resulting in a 'W' grade, indicating that no refund will be issued. Students considering withdrawal should be aware of this policy.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University hosts Ayesha Abed T-10 Inter-University Women's Cricket Tournament to mark its 25th anniversary
bracu_official.summary: To commemorate its 25th anniversary, BRAC University proudly hosted the Ayesha Abed T-10 Inter-University Women's Cricket Tournament. The event celebrated both the university's milestone and women's sports.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University career fair draws 80 of country’s renowned employers
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University's recent career fair attracted an impressive turnout of 80 renowned employers from across the country. The event provided valuable opportunities for students to connect with potential employers.

bracu_official.title: Cambridge researcher explores collaborative solutions to complex social challenges at BRAC University
bracu_official.summary: A researcher from Cambridge University visited BRAC University to discuss and explore collaborative solutions for various complex social challenges. The visit fostered academic exchange and discussion on critical issues.
